= Dialogue substitution parity

.Documented conflict
-- Come here! -- I said. +
-- What is it? -- replied Lance.

.Documented workaround
[%hardbreaks]
-- Come here! -- I said.
{empty}
-- What is it? -- replied Lance.

.No substitutions
[subs=none]
-- First line. +
-- Second line.

.No post replacements
[subs=-post_replacements]
-- First line. +
-- Second line.

.No replacements
[subs=-replacements]
-- First line. +
-- Second line.

.No attributes in the workaround
[%hardbreaks,subs=-attributes]
-- First line.
{empty}
-- Second line.

.No replacements in the workaround
[%hardbreaks,subs=-replacements]
-- First line.
{empty}
-- Second line.

.No post replacements in the workaround
[%hardbreaks,subs=-post_replacements]
-- First line.
{empty}
-- Second line.

.Replacements before post replacements
[subs="specialchars,replacements,post_replacements"]

-- Second line.

.Post replacements before replacements
[subs="specialchars,post_replacements,replacements"]
-- First line. +
-- Second line.

.Replacements moved after post replacements
[subs="-replacements,+replacements"]
-- First line. +
-- Second line.
